response.justification: Bogdan has extensive backend and systems experience with multiple languages, but his primary expertise aligns more with web/mobile development and scripting languages (TypeScript, Node.js, D, JavaScript) rather than the required C++/Rust focus for routing tiling. His geospatial work (GISCollective) is promising but lacks depth in navigation systems or high-performance data pipelines. The resume does not highlight distributed systems, fault tolerance, or low-latency applications required for this role.
strengths: Strong backend and systems programming background, including low-latency applications (Dlang, Node.js)
Experience with geospatial data processing (GISCollective) and open-source contributions
Proven ability to learn new technologies and adapt to diverse tech stacks
concerns: Limited direct experience with C++/Rust, the primary languages required for this role
No clear evidence of working with routing systems, navigation data pipelines, or distributed systems relevant to the job
Geospatial work is more aligned with mapping applications than high-performance routing tiling
